products.name: Navel Oranges

products.name: Seedless Watermelon Wedge

products.name: Strawberries

products.name: Lemons

products.name: Limes

products.name: Green Seedless Grapes

products.name: Imperial Mandarins

products.name: Kensington Pride Mango

products.name: Whole Pineapple

products.name: Raspberries

products.name: Broccoli Head

products.name: Baby Spinach

products.name: Iceberg Lettuce

products.name: Cos Lettuce

products.name: Truss Tomatoes

products.name: Cherry Tomatoes

products.name: Lebanese Cucumbers

products.name: Carrots

products.name: Brushed Potatoes

products.name: Gold Sweet Potatoes

products.name: Brown Onions

products.name: Red Onions

products.name: Garlic Bulb

products.name: Hand Sanitiser Gel
products.description: A 250 ml pump of alcohol-based hand sanitiser gel. Keep one in the bag and one by the door.

products.name: Facial Tissues 6 Pack
products.description: Six boxes of soft two-ply facial tissues. The hay-fever and winter-cold drawer filler.

products.name: Light Moisturiser
products.description: A light, fast-absorbing face and body moisturiser with no heavy fragrance. Suitable for normal to combination skin.

products.name: SPF 50 Plus Sunscreen
products.description: A broad-spectrum SPF 50+ lotion for face and body, water resistant for 40 minutes. An Australian summer essential; reapply often.

products.name: SPF Lip Balm
products.description: A stick lip balm with SPF 30 and a hint of vanilla. Contains lanolin derived from wool, so it is vegetarian but not vegan.

products.name: Nappies Size 3 Mid Pack
products.description: A mid pack of size 3 nappies for babies roughly 6 to 11 kg, with a wetness indicator and stretchy sides.

products.name: Fragrance Free Baby Wipes
products.description: Fragrance-free, unscented baby wipes that are also useful for sticky hands and faces on the go.

products.name: Infant Formula Stage 1
products.description: A stage 1 infant formula from birth, to be prepared exactly as the tin directs. This is not a substitute for professional feeding advice. Contains milk and soy.

products.name: Pear and Apple Baby Puree
products.description: A simple pear and apple puree pouch for babies starting solids, with no added sugar or salt. Always check age guidance on the pack.

products.name: Gentle Baby Shampoo
products.description: A tear-reduced, fragrance-light baby shampoo and wash in one. Gentle enough for daily baths.

products.name: Adult Dry Dog Food Chicken
products.description: An 8 kg bag of adult dry dog food with chicken as the first ingredient. Complete and balanced for adult dogs; transition slowly from the previous food.

products.name: Wet Dog Food Tins Mixed
products.description: Six mixed-flavour wet dog food tins to spoon over dry food or serve on their own. A useful topper for fussy eaters.

products.name: Adult Dry Cat Food
products.description: A 3 kg bag of adult dry cat food with a fish and chicken recipe. Complete nutrition for indoor and outdoor adult cats. Contains fish.

products.name: Wet Cat Food Pouches
products.description: Twelve gravy pouches in mixed fish and chicken flavours. A convenient wet meal or topper. Contain fish.

products.name: Clumping Cat Litter
products.description: A 10-litre bag of unscented clumping clay litter that forms firm scoops and controls odour when the tray is kept clean.

products.name: Dog Training Treats
products.description: Small, soft dog training treats with a strong aroma, sized for repeated rewards on a walk or in a class.

products.name: Hot Roast Chicken
products.description: A seasoned whole roast chicken, sold hot from the deli counter and also available chilled the next morning. A last-minute dinner with salad or bread.

products.name: Fresh Fettuccine
products.description: Fresh egg fettuccine that cooks in two to three minutes. Toss with butter, pepper, and parmesan, or a slow ragu. Contains gluten and egg.

products.name: Classic Hummus
products.description: A classic chickpea hummus with tahini, lemon, and olive oil. A fridge staple for lunchboxes and mezze. Contains sesame.

products.name: Roast Capsicum Dip
products.description: A smoky roast capsicum dip loosened with a little yoghurt. Serve with crackers or vegetable sticks. Contains milk.

products.name: Sliced Champagne Ham
products.description: Thinly sliced champagne-style ham, mildly sweet and ready for sandwiches. Keep refrigerated and use within a few days of opening.

products.name: Sliced Turkey Breast
products.description: Lean sliced turkey breast with a clean, lightly seasoned flavour. A lighter sandwich filling than ham.

products.name: Classic Coleslaw
products.description: A creamy cabbage-and-carrot coleslaw in a mayonnaise dressing. A barbecue side that is not vegan; contains egg and milk.

products.name: Pumpkin and Ginger Soup
products.description: A chilled fresh soup of roasted pumpkin and ginger, ready to heat. Smooth and mildly spiced; contains cream (milk).

products.name: Garden Salad Kit
products.description: A bagged garden salad kit with leaves, a sachet of dressing, and a sprinkle of cheese. Toss just before serving. Contains milk in the dressing and cheese.

products.name: Spinach and Feta Quiche
products.description: A small spinach and feta quiche with a shortcrust base, ready to eat cold or warmed. Contains gluten, egg, and milk.

products.name: Salmon and Avocado Sushi Pack
products.description: A chilled pack of salmon and avocado rolls with soy sauce and pickled ginger. Eat the same day; contains fish, soy, and sesame. Keep refrigerated.

products.name: Ricotta and Spinach Ravioli
products.description: Fresh ravioli filled with ricotta and spinach. Boil for three minutes and finish with butter and sage, or a light tomato sauce. Contains gluten, egg, and milk.

products.name: Falafel Mix Ready to Fry
products.description: A chilled falafel mix, already seasoned, ready to shape and fry or bake. Serve in wraps with hummus and salad. Contains gluten and sesame.
